stem: A trial compares two canopy-training intensities. Yield is similar, but the heavier treatment adds labor and increases stem injury. What conclusion best fits the evidence?
choices: The heavier treatment has not shown enough benefit to justify its added labor and injury cost under these conditions
The heavier treatment is superior because more work was performed
The lighter treatment must reduce quality
The trial proves neither treatment can ever be used
rationale: A production method should be judged by net operational benefit, not intervention intensity alone.
